site.tagline: The tools, workflow and writing behind how I work with AI
site.description: Fabio Akita's open source AI toolkit: ai-usagebar, ghpending, tclock, my agent skills and ai-memory, plus the LLM benchmark and the writing that documents it all.
site.ogAlt: Akita's AI Toolkit: tools, workflow and writing. A small dashboard with a red pixel clock, an amber list, a blue gauge and a violet chip.
